verdict_reason: The new public DTO is otherwise a correct 1-based page wrapper, but it ships without the required OpenAPI @Schema annotations.

todos.issue: Public page-response record and its fields have no @Schema annotations, so SpringDoc omits descriptions and requiredMode (which can silently break generated clients).
todos.fix: Annotate the record and each component with @Schema(description, requiredMode=REQUIRED), matching java/openapi-springdoc.md DTO defaults.
